title: Mixing: Give Me Something by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 30 September 1980.

It was for just one song: ‘Give Me Something’ by Ono. The session took place from 4pm until 6am the following morning.
